## ServiceNow Non-GAAP Net Income — FY2025

**Basis note:** ServiceNow's fiscal year coincides with the calendar year, so "fiscal year 2025" is the twelve months ended December 31, 2025 — no fiscal-year mismatch issue. However, one caveat on sourcing: the excerpt available provides the GAAP starting point and each reconciling adjustment, but the summed "Non-GAAP net income" total line itself is not shown in the retrieved text. The figure below is therefore **derived** by summing the disclosed reconciliation components.

| Line item | Amount |
|---|---|

| Stock-based compensation | +$1,955 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Amortization of purchased intangibles | +$120 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Business combination and other related costs | +$109 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Impairment of assets | +$30 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Severance costs | +$74 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Legal settlements | $0 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Contract termination costs | +$37 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| Income tax effects and adjustments | −$404 [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt] |
| **Non-GAAP net income (derived)** | **$3,669** |

### Observations
- Stock-based compensation ($1,955M) is by far the largest adjustment — it alone exceeds GAAP net income, and drives more than 95% of the gap between the GAAP and non-GAAP figures [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_netincome.txt].
- Non-GAAP net income of ~$3,669M is roughly **2.1x** GAAP net income of $1,748M.
- The same adjustment set (SBC, intangibles amortization, business combination costs, impairment, severance, contract termination) is applied to the operating income reconciliation, which builds from GAAP income from operations of $1,824M to a non-GAAP figure of ~$4,149M; the net income reconciliation differs by adding the $(404)M tax effect [DOC: servicenow_8k_fy2025_opinc.txt].

ANSWER: Approximately $3,669 million (~$3.67 billion), derived by summing the disclosed reconciliation items from GAAP net income of $1,748 million for the year ended December 31, 2025
